mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST) above 570,000 units and retail sales (RSAFS) above $350 billion indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST > 570.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) triggers Federal Reserve tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 96.0 indicates strong manufacturing output and capacity utilization, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 96.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 550,000 units for two consecutive months signals weakening residential demand and reduced economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth above 100,000 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% indicate a tight labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 100000.0 and UNRATE < 5.0) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Negative GDP growth (GDPC1 decline) signals economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during recessionary periods.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 shows negative growth.
